articles.body:
While exploring the island, you'll not only uncover new areas but also meet new friends, which includes a fluffy puppy named Cinnamoroll. On this page of IGN's Hello Kitty Island Adventure guide , you'll learn more about this doggy turned mail courier, including what gifts to give him, friendship rewards, quests , and more.

Cinnamoroll is a tiny, white, fluffy dog who runs the mail delivery service on the island. Unlike the rest of the starter characters, however, Cinnamoroll isn't a passenger on the plane. Instead, you'll meet him once you arrive on the island and befriend another passenger. Described as a shy but helpful pup, Cinnamoroll is always there when his friends need him.

While some of your fellow passengers on the plane will be scattered throughout the island and visible on the map, Cinnamoroll will not. Finding and meeting him will be a part of the Delivery Service quest which you can start after you find and befriend Kuromi in the Spooky Swamp . During this quest, you'll meet Cinnamoroll and eventually unlock the fast travel ability. Be sure to check out our complete guide on how to unlock fast travel and meet Cinnamoroll .

Below is a table that lists the best gifts to give Cinnamoroll to raise his friendship level, along with their value.

Cinnamoroll likes gifts that are tagged with Coffee , Chocolate , or Spicy . He's one of the most difficult Characters to gift early on in Hello Kitty Island Adventure.

We recommend starting with Spicy Pizza if you haven't yet completed the Power Up the Gate quest and unlocked the Snorkel . Once you can dive and visit Hangyodon's Comedy Club to use the Espresso Station , collect Chocolate Coins to craft Mocha for a good two-heart gift . You will need the following ingredients to craft a Mocha:

Candlenuts are rewarded by Hangyodon for gifting him every day, and you will earn more Candlenuts depending on tier of gift you give him.

Cinnamoroll's three-heart gift is Chocolate Chai Latte . Before you can craft the Chocolate Chai Latte at the Espresso Station in Hangyodon's Comedy Club , you will need to unlock the Espresso Station upgrade which allows you to use two ingredients in addition to Candlenuts. You need to reach Friendship Level 4 with Hangyodon to upgrade the Espresso Station so you can craft Chocolate Chai Latte.

Cinnamoroll Friendship Levels and Rewards

Increasing your friendship level with island residents is not only important to progress through the game's story but doing so will also unlock different items, tools, and quests. Below is a list of rewards earned as you level up your friendship with Cinnamoroll.

As your friendship grows with a character, you'll unlock various quests when you reach a certain level. Completing these quests usually involves helping them complete a task and can earn you rewards like special items, outfits, crafting plans, and even unlocking additional island residents who weren't on the plane at the beginning of the game.

Below is a list of all of the friendship quests available for Cinnamoroll. Be sure to check out our dedicated quest guide which will tell you how to unlock each quest and the rewards for completing them.

Characters also have daily quests you can complete to earn extra friendship points with them. Below is a list of Daily Quests for Cinnamoroll.

Up Next: Pekkle Best Gifts, Rewards, and Quests

articles.title: Helmet and Hat Locations - Ghost of Yotei Guide - IGN
articles.summary: Helmets are a type of Vanity Item in Ghost of Yotei, pieces of headgear that Atsu can wear on her head (of course), including hats, actual helmets, headbands
articles.body:
Helmets are a type of Vanity Item in Ghost of Yotei , pieces of headgear that Atsu can wear on her head (of course), including hats, actual helmets, headbands and more. Similar to Masks , they’re purely cosmetic, and do not offer any gameplay benefits. They can be acquired via many means, including looting off of Bounties, purchased from Merchants, or found lying around the world of Ezo. In this section of our Ghost of Yotei guide, we’ll help you get every Helmet in the game, including in the Echoes of Sekigahara DLC and Most Wanted mode !

Outfit Hats are the Hats and Helmets that are associated with the unlockable Outfits in the game. There's a few other hats included here as well, including archer's hats from a few Sumi-e Paintings, and Ainu hats for the Robes for Sitturaynu.

A hat stolen from the streets of Osaka. Shows the wear and tear of war and harsh weather.

The Lone Wolf’s Straw Hat is the hat that you begin the game with, so there’s no need to go out searching for this one.

Prerequisite: Defeat Lord Saito in Most Wanted

How to get: Buy the Joy of the Stars Dye for 10 Boss Tokens

The Loyalty in the Stars Hat is exclusive to the Most Wanted mode, and references the Astro Bot games. To get it, you'll need to defeat Lord Saito in this mode, then buy the Joy of the Stars dye for the Onryō Armor, which costs 10 Boss Tokens from the Most Wanted Merchant.

How to get: Complete the “ Soma the Condemned ” Bounty quest

The Bounty Master Headband is one of the rewards for completing the “ Soma the Condemned ” Bounty in the Yotei Grasslands. This bounty does not become available until after you complete the “ Muneji the Bone Crusher ” Bounty, also in the Yotei Grasslands.

Once you’ve done that, you can start Soma the Condemned at a door just west of Lake Jozan, which is in the northwestern area of the Yotei Grasslands.

The sound of coin. Blood wiped from a blade.

Upgrade the Bounty Master Armor to Level III

The Bounty Legend Headband can be obtained by collecting the Bounty Master Armor, then upgrading it to Level III at Ginji the Armorer. Ginji can be found at every Inn, or summoned directly to a fresh campsite via the Wolf Pack menu.

It’s nothing personal. Just good business.

How to get: Upgrade the Bounty Master Armor to Level IV

The Bounty Master Straw Hat can be obtained by collecting the Bounty Master Armor, then upgrading it to Level IV at Ginji the Armorer. Ginji can be found at every Inn, or summoned directly to a fresh campsite via the Wolf Pack menu.

A straw hat that will protect from the sun but not the rain.

Location: Ishikari Plain - Ishikari Market

How to get: Start the “ Belly of the Beast ” Revenge quest

The Old Straw Hat is a Helmet that’s acquired automatically at the start of the “ Belly of the Beast ” Revenge quest, after which Atsu gets to keep it. This will be part of the main questline in Ishikari Plain.

Cost: 3 Ghost Flowers at the Mysterious Merchant.

The Scorched Straw Hat is one of the hats available from the Mysterious Merchant, Masujiro the Melodious, who is only accessible in New Game + . It will cost you 3 Ghost Flowers.

You can find Masujiro the Melodious right from the start of New Game + : his camp is one of the locations Atsu spots with her Spyglass immediately after the title card. He'll be in a cluster of trees directly between Atsu's Home and the Yotei's Shadow Inn.

Rest the hardships you carry in the shade.

Location: Nayoro Wilds - Cukpet Hills - Iwor Woods

The Burdened Straw Hat can be found in Cukpet Hills, an area in the southern part of the Nayoro Wilds.

Specifically, it can be found from the lake where the “Iwor Woods” settlement is in the southeastern corner (NOT to be confused with the Iwor Woods area to the north of it).

Head for the settlement and locate the lake behind it. Here, check the cliffs on the northeastern bank of the lake to find some handholds to climb up.

At the top, squeeze through the narrow passage on your left to find a campsite. The Burdened Straw Hat can be looted from a chest on the right-hand side of the camp.

Location: Tokachi Range - Ohara Plains - Cairn Forks

How to get: Complete “ The Dragonfly Armor ” Tale quest

The Dragonfly’s Prey Helmet is unlocked for completing “ The Dragonfly Armor ” Tale quest, and comes with the main Dragonfly Armor outfit itself.

You can start this Tale at Cairn Forks, a campsite on an island in the middle of the river running along the southern edge of Ohara Plains. Visit this spot and talk to Daijiro to begin the Tale quest.

How to get: Upgrade the Dragonfly Armor to Level II

The Dragonfly’s Flight Helmet can be obtained by collecting the Dragonfly Armor, then upgrading it to Level II at Ginji the Armorer. Ginji can be found at every Inn, or summoned directly to a fresh campsite via the Wolf Pack menu.

How to get: Upgrade the Dragonfly Armor to Level IV

The Dragonfly’s Rebirth Helmet can be obtained by collecting the Dragonfly Armor, then upgrading it to Level IV at Ginji the Armorer. Ginji can be found at every Inn, or summoned directly to a fresh campsite via the Wolf Pack menu.

Location: Oshima Coast - Matsumae Castle - Imperial Sakura Sumi-e

The Hat of Refinement is the reward for completing the Imperial Sakura Sumi-e Painting, which can be found in Castle Matsumae in Oshima Coast.

The Imperial Sakura Sumi-e Painting can be found in the ground of Matsumae Castle, located in the middle of the Oshima Coast region. You can find it in a secluded garden at the southeastern corner of the castle's moat.

Frogs in the meadow. A child’s laughter.

Location: Yotei Grasslands - Lake Jozan - Chasing Frogs Sumi-e

The Hat of Youth is the reward for the Chasing Frogs Sumi-e at Lake Jozan, which is in the northwestern corner of the Yotei Grasslands.

At the southwestern bank of Lake Jozan, look for the telltale rock that’s tall and has the yellow-flowered vines growing on it, which marks where the Sumi-e is. Complete the painting to get the Hat of Youth as a reward.

Location: Ishikari Plain - Nagoya Spring - Chatting Crows Sumi-e

Crows chatter. Will it be words of the divine, or conspiring mischief?

The Hat of Messengers is the reward for completing the Chatting Crows Sumi-e Painting. This can be found in Nakagoya Spring, which is in the eastern area of the Ishikari Plain region. It will be on the river that runs east to the Winding Tears Shrine, and is south of Nohoro Cave.

Partway up the river will be a small waterfall with a dead tree hanging over it covered in crows. Near the dead tree will be the painting spot, marked as ever by the tall rock with yellow-flowered vines covering it.

Crabs on the beach. A flower catches their attention.

Location: Yotei Grasslands - Southern Coast - Careful Pincers Sumi-e

The Hat of Curiosity can be obtained by completing the Careful Pincers Sumi-e Painting. It can be found on the Southern Coast, in the southwestern part of the opening Yotei Grasslands area.

You’ll be looking for a large rock on the shore covered in yellow flowers, close to a gravel slope. The painting spot will be on the flat rock surface next to it. Completing it will reward you with the Hat of Curiosity!

Location: Nayoro Wilds - Iwor Mountains - Husko Kotan

How to get: Complete “ The Heart of an Ainu ” Tale quest

The Traveller’s Dawn Headband is acquired as part of “ The Heart of an Ainu ” Tale quest, and comes with the ”Robes for Sitturaynu” Outfit. You start working towards this quest by first talking to huci at the Central Ferry at the northern tip of Tokachi Range.

After using the ferry to get past the Great Lake, find and talk to huci on the western side of the Ainu town to start The Heart of an Ainu proper. Complete it to get this headband!

Of Ainu make. A winding road. An unexpected turn.

Location: Nayoro Wilds - Iwor Mountains - Husko Kotan - Kaeka the Weaver

How to get: Upgrade the Robes for Sitturaynu to Level III

The Traveller’s Journey Headband is an advanced version of the Traveller’s Dawn Headband. To get it, you’ll need to upgrade the Robes for Sitturaynu to Level III.

Upgrading the robes doesn’t work like any of the other Outfits in the game. Rather than visiting Ginji the Armorer, you instead have to visit Kaeka the Weaver outside the Husko Kotan. This building is in the Ainu Village in Iwor Mountains, which is in the northern half of the Nayoro Wilds.

How to get: Upgrade the Robes for Sitturaynu to Level IV

The Traveller’s Dusk Hat is the most advanced version of the Traveller’s Dawn Headband. To get it, you’ll need to upgrade the Robes for Sitturaynu to Level IV.

Of Ainu make. Step into the water. Journey to the horizon.

Prerequisite: Complete " The Way of the Shamisen " Revenge quest

The Sand and Tide Hat is a Vanity Item that is unlocked by completing " The Way of the Shamisen " Revenge quest up in Teshio Ridge. After completing it, you can then visit any AInu Merchant and buy it from them for 10 Flowers.

Of Ainu make. May those we love be protected by the things we make for them.

The Weaver’s Hope Hat can be found by visiting an Ainu Merchant. These nomadic folk can often be found wandering the open fields of Ezo, but if you want a guaranteed spot to find them, head north through to the Nayoro Wilds region, past the Great Lake.

After a boat ride, you’ll arrive in Husko Kotan, with some Ainu Merchants in the southwestern side of town.

Of Ainu Make. A gift from huci’s son for helping him and his mother reconnect.

How to get: Complete “ The Load We Bear ” Tale quest.

The Thoughts on the Ocean Hat is a cosmetic unlocked for completing “The Load We Bear” Tale quest. It can be started by talking with huci’s son outside her house, but it isn’t immediately available.

This quest is unlocked after you first complete “ The Heart of the Ainu ” with huci. Once you’ve done that, you can start “ The Load We Bear ” by talking to huci’s son outside her house.

Of Ainu make. Let that which burdens you get lost on the path behind you.

The Thoughts on the Road Hat can be found by visiting an Ainu Merchant. These nomadic folk can often be found wandering the open fields of Ezo, but if you want a guaranteed spot to find them, head north through to the Nayoro Wilds region, past the Great Lake.

When life has not been kind, we survive.

How to get: Upgrade Taro’s Armor to Level II

The Resilient Headband can be obtained by collecting Taro’s Armor, then upgrading it to Level II at Ginji the Armorer. Ginji can be found at every Inn, or summoned directly to a fresh campsite via the Wolf Pack menu.

You can get Taro’s Armor by meeting the scavenger for the first time. He’s normally encountered out in the open world, but if you want a guaranteed spot to find him, you can visit Dead Man’s Tree at Ohara Plains, in the western area of Tokachi Range.

How to get: Upgrade Taro’s Armor to Level IV

The Resilient Straw Hat can be obtained by collecting Taro’s Armor, then upgrading it to Level IV at Ginji the Armorer. Ginji can be found at every Inn, or summoned directly to a fresh campsite via the Wolf Pack menu.

Location: Tokachi Range - Abandoned Tominaga Estate

How to get: Complete “ The Spider Lily General ” Myth quest

The Spider Lily Headband is acquired with the accompanying armor as part of “ The Spider Lily General ” Myth quest. This can be started at the Mysterious Gate in the southeastern part of Tokachi Range, located south of Shizunai Woods and east of Yamane Bluffs.

Defeat the boss, then make sure to pick up the armor on your way out to get this headband as well!

A general at peace, his memory not forgotten.

How to get: Upgrade the Spider Lily Armor to Level IV

The Spider Lily Helmet can be obtained by collecting the Spider Lily Armor, then upgrading it to Level IV at Ginji the Armorer. Ginji can be found at every Inn, or summoned directly to a fresh campsite via the Wolf Pack menu.

The Impatient Brawl Headband can be found in Ishiusu Basin, the southwestern area of the Tokachi Range region. It’s north of the Ishiusu Basin label on the map screen, and east-south-east of the Reliquary of Resilience.

At this spot on the eastern side of a path will be a rocky rise, with a tree and a Bounty signpost on top, nestled between two white flower roads. Here will be a wooden chest and a skeleton: the Impatient Brawl Headband is inside the chest (the skeleton has nothing).

Location: Ishikari Plain - Nagoya Spring - Storyteller’s Rest

How to get: Complete “ The Undying Samurai ” Myth quest

The Helmet of the Prideful is a reward for completing “ The Undying Samurai ” Myth Quest in Ishikari Plain. You can find it at Storyteller’s Rest, in the northwestern area of Nakagoya Spring.

You’ll be looking for Ugetsu the storyteller sitting under a low tree: he’ll be on the road that passes by the southeastern side of the Masked Man’s Quarry.

How to get: Upgrade the Armor of the Undying to Level II

The Helmet of the Punished can be obtained by collecting the Armor of the Undying, then upgrading it to Level II at Ginji the Armorer. Ginji can be found at every Inn, or summoned directly to a fresh campsite via the Wolf Pack menu.

How to get: Upgrade the Armor of the Undying to Level IV

The Helmet of the Punished can be obtained by collecting the Armor of the Undying, then upgrading it to Level IV at Ginji the Armorer. Ginji can be found at every Inn, or summoned directly to a fresh campsite via the Wolf Pack menu.

How to get: Complete the " Blood on the Snow " Revenge quest

The Nine Tail Acolyte Headband can be acquired by completing the " Blood on the Snow " Revenge quest, which is the first proper main story quest in Teshio Ridge. To start it, enter the Red Crane Inn, which Atsu spotted when first entering the region.

You'll get the Nine Tail Acolyte Headband alongside the Nine Tail Armor at the end of the quest.

How to get: Upgrade the Nine Tail Armor to Level II.

The Nine Tail Apprentice Headband can be obtained by collecting the Nine Tail Armor, then upgrading it to Level II at Ginji the Armorer. Ginji can be found at every Inn, or summoned directly to a fresh campsite via the Wolf Pack menu.

How to get: Upgrade the Nine Tail Armor to Level IV.

The Nine Tail Master Hat can be obtained by collecting the Nine Tail Armor, then upgrading it to Level IV at Ginji the Armorer. Ginji can be found at every Inn, or summoned directly to a fresh campsite via the Wolf Pack menu.

How to get: Complete the “Pride Before Tea” Sensei quest

The Ginji’s Guard Helmet is one of the rewards for completing the “Pride Before Tea” Sensei quest, which can be done in the Oshima Coast region.

While there are a few spots to start this quest, the fastest way to just get going with it is to head to the mouth of the Oyobe River in the eastern part of Oshima Coast. Here you’ll find Ginji and a few men next to the bridge: talk to him to start the quest.

The Miscellaneous Hats really don't fit in any other category. They include some leftover armored helmets and headbands, a wooden circular hat, and the three sandogasa hats that are like straw hats, but aren't actually made out of straw.

All Mischellaneous Hats in Ghost of Yotei

A helmet that begs the question if one can have too much plumage.

Location: Ishikari Plain - Matsumae Encampment - Bamboo Strike

This helmet is actually one you’ll always pick up if you continue down the story, as you must do in the process of “ The Road to Ishikari Plain ” during “The Oni” Revenge quest. During your brief stay at the Matsumae Encampment in Ishikari Plain, you’ll be challenged by a Samurai to keep your own sword (the nerve!).

Best his challenge, and not only will you continue on the journey of earning more Spirit, but you’ll also win his hat, the Helmet of Clan Matsumae!

A familiar helmet with a splash of color.

This helmet is also one you’ll always pick up if you continue down the story, as you must do in the process of “ The Road to Ishikari Plain ” during “The Oni” Revenge quest. The catch is, you can only get this one in New Game + !

During your brief stay at the Matsumae Encampment in Ishikari Plain, you’ll be challenged by a Samurai to keep your own sword (the nerve! Again!). Best his challenge, and you'll get this even more flamboyant version of the Clan Matsumae Helmet!

The heirloom of an ancient samurai clan…

Prerequisite: Progress “ The Storm Blade ” Myth quest

Location: Oshima Coast - Forgotten Shrine - Lost Shinobi Den

The Stag Helmet is a unique and nostalgic helmet found in Oshima Coast. It’s located in the Forgotten Shrine, the misty and mossy area in the southwestern corner of the bay in Oshima Coast. There are two notes to make about the Stag Helmet:

First, acquiring it also unlocks the Stag Helmet for the Samurai Class in the Legends Mode.

Second, the Stag Helmet gains additional Dyes when you buy them for the Sakai Armor in the Most Wanted mode, which become available after unlocking Jin Sakai.

To enter the Forgotten Shrine area, you must also pick up “ The Storm Blade ” Myth Quest. No way to avoid it!

As you go through the misty and mossy valley, you’ll pass through the Glade of Remembrance, and then appear in the Lost Shinobi Den, which has a waterfall, an abandoned shack, and many plain white banners.

Enter the shack, then turn right to enter the right-hand room. Turn left to spot the Stag Helmet on top of some orange drawers, next to a ladder leading up to the roof and the path onwards.

A travelling hat made for those who do not wish to show their face.

Location: Yotei Grasslands - Nupur River - Crow’s Nest Watchtower

The Veiled Sandogasa Hat can be found at the Crow’s Nest Watchtower, on the eastern side of Nupur River in the northeastern part of the Yotei Grasslands.

The watchtower will be east-northeast of the Yotei’s Shadow Inn, and just south of the Nupur River Bamboo Strike. Climb to the top of the watchtower to find an old man being bothered by crows fighting on the roof.

To get up there, stand in the middle of the floor, face north, then jump on the spot to grab onto the roof and climb up. The Veiled Sandogasa Hat will be there, and you’ll scare away the crows!

Taken from a bounty who fed his enemies to the crows.

Location: Yotei Grasslands - Jade Grove - The Blue-Flowered Cemetery

Cost if missed: 200 Coin from Taro the Scavenger

To get Crow Genzo’s Sandogasa Hat, you must first kill Crow Genzo at The Blue-Flowered Cemetery, located in Jade Grove on the western border of the Yotei Grasslands.

Once you’ve faced Crow Genzo (and anyone else who shows up), loot the hat off Crow Genzo’s body! If you miss it, you can buy it off Taro the Scavenger for 200 Coin. He has a guaranteed spawn point at Dead Man’s Tree, located in Ohara Plains in the Tokachi Range region.

This Hat can be found in the Yubari Lake area, which is in the western-most part of the Tokachi Range region.

It can be found at a location in the woods just west of the Yubari Lake label on the map screen, and is just east of the Monument Tree. Here you can find the corpses of a man and a bear sitting at the base of a tree on a rock. The hat will be next to the man’s corpse.

The Scarlet Aid Hat can be found on the Iwor Woods mountain trail, which you traverse down in “The Heart of an Ainu” Tale quest.

The mountain trail is in the Iwor Woods, on the eastern border of Naroyo Wilds’ northern half.

When you climb up to the second log on the trail, don’t cross it! Instead, look left of it to spot some handholds in the rock wall.

At the top of the second set of handholds will be an abandoned camp with two chests. Open the smaller chest in the back to get the Scarlet Aid Hat!

Prerequisite: Clear four Revenge quest cards

How to get: Get captured by Saito's Black Guard, then loot from the camp's chest.

The Golden Fire Hat is a hat that has a very unique method to acquire it. First, you'll need to clear four Revenge quest cards to increase Atsu's notoreity. Doing this will cause her enemies to escalate their methods of catching her, until Saito sends out his dreaded Black Guard, the toughest enemies in the game. You'll want to get into an encounter with them!

You can tell the Black Guard are nearby by the sound of ominous drum beats. They like searching for Atsu near points of interest like Pillars of the Fallen, but it can be a bit of a pain trying to get to them to appear after having completed the main story.

Once you've met up with the Black Guard, you need to get killed by them. Even on the easiest difficulty this will be extremely quick to do, as they're the toughest enemies in the game. Do this, and instead of dying outright, Atsu will be captured and tied up on a pole at their nearby camp.

The camp will have two Black Guard soldiers, who you should Assassinate rather than fight head-on. Once they're dead, loot their wooden chest to find this hat inside!

Inspired by twilight barbarians from afar.

Cost: 5 Ghost Flowers from the Mysterious Merchant

The Dark Nanban Hat is one of the helmets available from the Mysterious Merchant, Masujiro the Melodious, who is only accessible in New Game + . It will cost you 5 Ghost Flowers.

Said to be inspired by barbarians from afar.

The Nanban Hat is a helmet available right from the start of the game, provided you can access an Ainu Merchant to buy it from. Once you have, you can buy it from them for 10 Flowers.

If you want a guaranteed spot to find an Ainu Merchant, you can find one in the southwestern area of Husko Kotan in the Nayoro Wilds.

Inspired by wealthy barbarians from afar.

The Golden Nanban Hat is a helmet that only becomes available once you reach the Merchant at the Red Crane Inn at Teshio Ridge. as available right from the start of the game, provided you can access an Ainu Merchant to buy it from.

Once you've made it there and found him, you can buy it from him for 10 Flowers.

The General Headbands encompass headbands that you can get either by buying them from vendors and merchants, or by finding them out in the open world of Ezo. The headbands you get by completing Sumi-e Paintings have their own section at the end of the Helmets list.

The Hidden Master Headband is a Helmet that only unlocks after speaking to the Merchant outside the Red Crane Inn in Teshio Ridge.

Once you've made it there, talk to the merchant and buy it off him for 3 Flowers.

Defiant against the cold and heat alike.

The Climber's Frost Headband is a Helmet that only unlocks once you've talked to the Merchant outside the Red Crane Inn in Teshio Ridge.

Once you've made it to him, you can buy it from him for 3 Flowers.

See the horse that rides the grasslands. See the rider that earned their respect.

Location: Teshio Ridge - Hakodake Mountains

The Rider's Will Headband can be found in the Hakodake Mountains, an area in the northern part of Teshio Ridge.

To find it, bring up the map screen and place a marker on the left side of the "H" in the Hakodake Mountains label.

At this spot in the side of the cliff is a tomb. Head inside to find a chest, which has the headband inside!

Prerequisite: Complete all seven Myth quests .

Location: Yotei Grasslands - Home of the Storyteller

The Storyteller's Spirit headband may be one of the last pieces of headgear you get in the regular game. This is because it can only be acquired after you complete all seven Myth quests across Ezo, one of which is in Oshima Coast, which you can't access until very late into the game.

Once you've done this, you'll want to seek out the Home of the Storyteller, Ugetsu's home in the Yotei Grasslands region. You can find it at the top of the hill south of Lake Shikotsu, in the southeastern part of the Yotei Grasslands.

Here, check the side of the hut to find a chest: open it to get this headband! Also don't forget to read the note pinned onto the hut close by.

Taken by an arch nemesis. Left alone to become a home.

Prerequisite: Complete your first Shrine

How to get: Complete the “A Memory of Pride” Memory quest

Jubei’s Lost Headband is a cosmetic that’s unlocked by completing a Memory quest, specifically “A Memory of Pride”, which unlocks after you complete your first Shrine (the climbing ones, not the Fox Den Inari Shrines).

Once you’ve done this, return to Atsu’s Home and check the spot between the house, well and Bamboo Strike to find Jubei’s silhouette within some yellow ginkgo leaves. Hold down the touchpad to switch back to the past, then talk to Jubei.

After the conversation, climb up onto the roof of the house and check the point where the wooden roof meets the thatched roof. A bird’s nest will be here, with Jubei’s Lost Headband!

The Eye of the Storm Headband is a cosmetic that can be found in Otsuki River, the river that runs along the western side of Oshima Coast.

From the Map screen, locate the path running along the southwestern bank of the river. You’ll want to place a marker on the path just southwest of the space between “Otsuki” and “River”.

At the spot will be a pagoda tower, which you’ll have to climb up. To do that, stand on the outer balcony of the pagoda, then jump out to one of the rooftop corners and latch onto it with the grapple hook. Pull Atsu up, then from there you can repeatedly jump in place to grab onto the rooftop above you.

When you get to the top, check the base of the finial spire for a bird’s nest: interact with it to get the headband!

A brush weighed with ink. A kind thought recorded.

Location: Teshio Ridge - Teshio River - Black Dye House

Cost: 3 Flowers at the Black Dye Merchant

The Stroke of Luck Headband is one of the initial items available from the Black Dye Merchant in Teshio Ridge.

You can find her home, the Black Dye House, near the western end of the Teshio River, just a bit west of the Frozen Moment Sumi-E Painting spot. You can buy this Helmet for 10 Flowers.

Snow falls overnight. The world awakens. Snow falls from a branch.

The Quiet Dawn Headband can be found in Teshio Ridge, although it's in a spot with no region names nearby to help us guide you there. It'll be a bit south-southwest of a Pillar of the Fallen, and south of the Old House from the end of the " Crimson Kimono " Myth quest.

Search the cliff at this spot for a frozen waterfall area. Slip through the gap and climb up the ledges to find a chest at the base of a tall flag. The Quiet Dawn Headband will be inside!

The Ronin’s Headband is located in Hidaka Grove, an area in the northeastern part of Tokachi Range.

Just north of the entrance to the Faithful Leap Shrine will be a small lake, with an abandoned Matsumae camp surrounding it. Check the storage shelter on the southern side of the lake for a chest, which has the Ronin’s Headband inside.

Flowers sway in the wind. A moment passes. A thought flutters.

The Peace of the Grasslands Hat can be found by visiting an Ainu Merchant. These nomadic folk can often be found wandering the open fields of Ezo, but if you want a guaranteed spot to find them, head north through to the Nayoro Wilds region, past the Great Lake.

Stand tall in the face of adversity. Bend in the face of change.

How to get: Complete " The Way of the Shamisen ", then talk to the Black Dye Merchant

The Steady Bamboo Headband is a unique Vanity Item because it's given as a freebie at a dye merchant. To get it, complete " The Way of the Shamisen " Revenge quest, then head to the Black Dye Merchant and talk to her. She'll give you this headband free of charge!

The Headband of the Phoenix is one of the hats available from the Mysterious Merchant, Masujiro the Melodious, who is only accessible in New Game +. It will cost you 3 Ghost Flowers.

You can find Masujiro the Melodious right from the start of New Game +: his camp is one of the locations Atsu spots with her Spyglass immediately after the title card. He'll be in a cluster of trees directly between Atsu's Home and the Yotei's Shadow Inn.

The Round and Straw Hats are the hats made of straw and the circular-brimmed hats and helmets acquired throughout the game, giving a very ronin-esque flair to them. And also an eyepatch, for some reason (the patch itself is round, we suppose?).

All Round and Straw Hats in Ghost of Yotei

A small memento from a reformed scoundrel.

Prerequisite: Complete the “ Shiro the Swindler ” Bounty

How to get: Complete the “Wayward Oni Raiders” Bounty

Shiro’s Straw Hat is a Vanity Item that doesn’t become available until you reach Oshima Coast. It’s unlocked by completing a Bounty, but it doesn’t unlock until you complete the “Shiro the Swindler” Bounty all the way up in Ishikari Plain first.

After you’ve done that, head for the Bounty Board in Matsumae Castle in Oshima Coast and pick up the “Wayward Oni Raiders” Bounty. Complete it to get this hat!

Complete the “ Shiro the Swindler ” Bounty

Complete the “Wayward Oni Raiders Bounty

Location: Oshima Coast - Otsuki River - Blue Dye House

The Vagabond’s Straw Hat is a Vanity Item you can get at the Blue Dye Merchant, however it doesn’t unlock until you complete two specific Bounties. The first is the “ Shiro the Swindler ” Bounty up in Ishikari Plain.

After you complete it, the “Wayward Oni Raiders” Bounty unlocks in Oshima Coast. Pick it up at the Matsumae Castle Bounty Board and progress it to completion.

Once you’ve done that, head for the Blue Dye Merchant, located on Otsuki River upstream from the Oiso Fishing Village. You can buy it for 3 Flowers.

Under her shadow, the forsaken rise again.

How to get: Solve any two Mountain Reliquaries

The Yotei’s Shelter Hat is obtained by solving any two Mountain Reliquary puzzles in Ezo. It doesn’t matter which two you solve: it will always be the reward for your second!

Location: Ishikari Plain - Ishikari Fork

The Iron Grace Hat is a Helmet cosmetic that can be found in Ishikari Fork, which is on the southeastern border of Ishikari Plain. It’ll be southeast of Ishikari Farm.

Check the huge cliff southeast of Ishikari Farm to find a very wide gravel slope area with solid rock ledges sticking out of it. Start climbing up here from the northern (ie left-hand) side, using a grapple trunk and a grapple swing as you go.

After a grapple swing, turn right and climb up the ledge to find a chest with the Iron Grace Hat inside!

Location: Tokachi Range - Yamane Bluffs - Abandoned Tominaga Estate

The Iron Spirit Hat is found in a unique location: it’ll be in the Abandoned Tominaga Estate, which is in the Yamane Bluffs area on the southern border of Tokachi Range. It’ll be behind the Mysterious Door, and is the location of “ The Spider Lily General ” Myth quest.

When you get to the main area of the estate at the top of the winding stairs, head for the main pagoda. You’ll want to climb up it: to do that, stand under a corner of the lowest rooftop, then jump and hit R2 (by default) to grapple onto it and begin your climb. Get to the top and check the base of the spire to find the Iron Spirit Hat!

The Hermit’s Defence Hat can be found by visiting an Ainu Merchant. These nomadic folk can often be found wandering the open fields of Ezo, but if you want a guaranteed spot to find them, head north through to the Nayoro Wilds region, past the Great Lake.

Location: Oshima Coast - Matsumae Castle

The Summer of Steel Hat is a Helmet that isn’t available until late in the game. To get it, you’ll need to make it to Oshima Coast, then head for Matsumae Castle at the northern shore of the bay.

Here, enter Matsumae Castle from the south and then head right to find a marketplace. Here you’ll find the Oshima Coast Merchant, who’ll be selling this for 3 Flowers.

Taken from a bounty who hated the shamisen enough to kill with its strings.

Location: Ishikari Plain - Stone Jaw Coast

How to get: Loot off of Bloody Strings Hachibee

Bloody Strings Hachibee’s Straw Hat is one of the rewards for completing the “ Bloody Strings Hachibee ” Bounty quest. After starting it at the local Bounty Board, you can find them at the Stone Jaw Coast.

Look for a parked caravan east of Stone Jaw Coast, just about the second “S” in the Stone Jaw Coast’s label on the map screen. Draw out Hachibee (it will always be your third attempt), defeat him, then loot his body to get his hat!

If you miss picking this up, you can buy it from Taro the Scavenger for 200 Coin.

A killer's hat, before it was stained with blood.

The Unblemished Straw Hat is one of the hats available from the Mysterious Merchant, Masujiro the Melodious, who is only accessible in New Game + . It will cost you 3 Ghost Flowers.

Location: Oshima Coast - Otsuki River - Seianji Temple

The Nightfall’s Shield Hat can be found at Seianji Temple, a building at the northwestern end of Otsuki River, the western-most point of the Oshima Coast region.

Here will be a large building with two rooftop layers. Use Atsu’s grapple hook to climb up via the corners of the rooftop until you get to the highest one. Head for the northwestern part of the rooftop to find this hat!

Reflect on the intangible. See between the threads of life.

Location: Yotei Grasslands - Lake Shikotsu

The Devoted Straw Hat can be found north of the Lake Shikotsu area on the eastern border of the Yotei Grasslands. Lake Shikotsu is where Atsu’s Home is located on its northern shoreline.

You’ll want to head to a spot directly north of Atsu’s Home. At the edge of the forest, look for two bloody corpses: one is leaning on the bottom of a tree, with this hat at his feet.

The sun shines on farmer and hunter alike.

The Grasslands Straw Hat can be found in the Jade Grove, an area on the western border of the Yotei Grasslands. On the map screen, place a marker right on the “JA” of the Jade Grove label.

Head to this spot to find an abandoned camp, with its occupants dead at the surrounding trees. On the collapsed wooden shelter structure will be the Grasslands Straw Hat.

Location: Tokachi Range - Boar’s Eye Cave - Suspicious Thicket

How to get: Find inside the underground maze in the “ Junpei the Snatcher ” Bounty quest

The Clan Matsumae Hat is found in the underground maze at the Suspicious Thicket in Boar’s Eye Cave, on the northern border of Tokachi Range. You cannot get in here however without also starting the “ Junpei the Snatcher ” Bounty quest.

Once you’ve gotten into the maze, head clockwise around the outside of the maze until you come to a wooden cage and a wall made of bamboo. Head around the opposite side of the bamboo wall to find the Clan Matsumae Hat sitting on a wooden table.

Beauty lies in the eye of the one who dies by your hand.

The Unbreakable Elegance Hat is a rather wonderful looking hat that can be found in the Tokuyama Hills, in the northern area of Oshima Coast.

On the Map screen, place a marker just south of the “Yam” in the Tokuyama Hills label on the map screen.

Here next to the path running along the base of a cliff is a destroyed Matsumae camp. Close to the campfire will be a chest: open it to get this hat!

When the worst comes, be the sliver of hope that breaks through.

Location: Ishikari Plain - Otaru Hills - Nishin Fishery

The Darkest Hour Hat is a wide-brimmed hat located in Ishikari Plain. Specifically it’s at the Nishin Fishery, on the coastline of Otaru Hills in the southwestern corner of the region.

You’ll be looking for a cave at the base of the cliff the Fishery is located next to. There’s a path running along the eastern side of the Fishery that will take you to it.

Yank down the rocks blocking the entrance into the cave, then squeeze through to find an abandoned camp. In the back-left corner will be a chest you can open, which contains this hat!

You are the tree that weathers every storm.

The Golden Perseverance Hat is a very pretty hat found in Shojin Hills, an area on the eastern border of the Oshima Coast region.

On the map screen, it’ll be directly between the Saito Artillery Outpost to the west and the Waterfall Wolf Den to the east. Place a marker here on the river.

At this spot of the river will be a large waterfall. The chest with the hat is halfway up it, so to get there, use the handholds and the grapple swing on the right-hand (southern) cliff wall to get to the platform next to the waterfall with the chest on it.

A vision of the ocean, its fury arrives in battle.

The Resplendent Pearl Hat is a dazzling piece of headgear that’s found in Benten Port on Oshima Coast, although navigating to it is a bit tricky.

To start, select either Benten Port or Matsumae Residences on the Map screen and fast travel to the Onryo Gift Altar.

When you arrive, turn left to spot a two storey building on the left-hand side of the main road. Enter the ground floor and climb up the ladder on the northern wall.

At the top, look near the left-hand corner of the room to find a chest, which has this hat inside!

Location: Ishikari Plain - Ishikari River - Ishikari Market

Cost: 3 Flowers at the Ishikari Plain Merchant / an Ainu Merchant

The Patched Straw Hat is a Helmet that is unlocked in Ishikari Plain. To access it, you’ll need to arrive in Ishikari Market, which is in the southwestern area of the Plain. Atsu will in fact point this out when scouting the Ishikari Plain when she first arrives.

While this hat can first be purchased from the Ishikari Plain Merchant, it also appears at Ainu Merchants across other areas of Ezo, after you’ve interacted with the Ishikari Plain Merchant.

Location: Ishikari Plain - Stone Jaw Coast - Crimson Dye Beach

Cost: 3 Flowers at the Crimson Dye Merchant

The Eternal Coal Hat can be found at the Crimson Dye Merchant in Ishikari Plain. To find her, head for the Crimson Dye Beach on Stone Jaw Coast, located north-northwest of Ishikari Castle.

Here you’ll find the Dye Merchant’s workplace, but she’s currently out on her boat. To summon her, locate the campfire and light a fire here to draw her to shore. Talk to her to access her wares, and this hat!

An attack from all sides. Pressure bound. Victory at hand.

The Koromodako’s Hat is a Helmet that isn’t available until late in the game. To get it, you’ll need to make it to Oshima Coast, then head for Matsumae Castle at the northern shore of the bay.

Riches are more easily claimed with eight arms.

The Koromodako's Victory Hat is one of the hats available from the Mysterious Merchant, Masujiro the Melodious, who is only accessible in New Game + . It will cost you 3 Ghost Flowers.

Fear the warrior standing before the mountain that breathes fire.

Location: Ishikari Plain - Ishikari River - Bear Rock

The Flaming Breath Hat is a hat that can be found at Bear Rock in Ishikari Plain.

It’ll be on the eastern bank of the Ishikari River, and is located directly west of the “Ishikari Fork” label on the map screen.

Approach Bear Rock from the southeastern side, and you’ll spot a series of handholds going up to the top. Use them to, well, get up to the top!

Once you get up there, check around the ledges to find a square chest, which has the Flaming Breath Hat inside.

A short prayer. The wind blows. We dash ahead with purpose.

Location: Ikachi Plain - Ishikari Castle

The Whispers of the Kami Hat is a Helmet that can be found under Ishikari Castle, which you access via a tunnel that cuts right under Ishikari Castle.

Its eastern entrance can be found directly west of the Horokanai Bluffs label on the map screen.

The other entrance is at the end of the road that leads north from the Ishikari Market, and is marked with tattered red Saito banners.

In the middle of the cave tunnel is a hidden camp, with some bamboo ramps on one of the side walls. In the middle of the ramps will be a fragile section of wall. What you’ll need to do is take one of the red barrels, place it in front of the fragile wall section, then shoot it with an arrow (from a safe distance, of course). HOWEVER, Scorch Bombs will work just as well if you have them!

On the other side is a chest with this hat inside, but be careful! Your handiwork will draw in five Oni Raiders, including a Brute!

The Crimson Mukade Hat can be found on the Teshio Coast, which is the western coast of the Teshio Ridge region.

You can find the spot northwest of an Altar of Reflection, and west of a Pillar of the Fallen.

North of the Altar of Reflection, you'll find the remains of a bloody battle between the Matsumae and the Nine Tails, with a trail of blood leading to the cliff edge overlooking the sea. Follow it to find a dead soldier propped up against a low wall, with this hat at his feet.

A way to stay cool as you pick mushrooms.

Location: Yotei Grasslands - Graven Meadow

The Forager’s Straw Hat is a helmet that can be found at the Graven Meadow. This is a mushroom-filled located that’s on the eastern border of the winding Sarubetsu River, and is directly west of the Saito Recruitment Camp.

Here, check the cliffs to the east of the Graven Meadow to find some handholds to climb up them. Up here will be a box overlooking the meadow, with the Forager’s Straw Hat inside.

A gaze with no direction. A blade with no master.

The Ronin’s Straw Hat can be found in the Cukpet Hills, an area on the southern border of Nayoro Wilds. Open up the map screen, then place a marker on the “C” of the Cukpet Hills label.

When you arrive at this location you’ll find a campsite. Open up the low chest under the wooden shelter to get this hat!

Won from Takezo the Unrivaled who remains unrivalled no more.

Prerequisite: Complete the “ Takezo the Unrivalled ” Myth quest

Location: Yotei Grasslands - Mount Yotei

The Straw Hat of the Unrivalled is awarded for completing “ The Five Teachings ” Myth quest, which is the follow-up to the “ Takezo the Unrivalled ” Myth quest.

This is an extremely difficult duel for when you can unlock it, particularly with the frostbite mechanic that kicks in part-way that gradually reduces Atsu’s maximum health, rendering all of Takezo’s attacks one-hit kills.

Since you also need to equip all five of Takezo’s Charms, your main advantages will come from your armor selection, its upgrades, what you place in the spare Charm Slot, and any unlocked Techniques. Visiting Bamboo Strikes to increase Atsu’s Spirit circles is also highly recommended.

Fields of bold reds. Glints of gold. A forest enters sleep.

Prerequisite: Complete “ The Five Teachings ” Myth quest

The Autumn Straw Hat is a helmet that must first be unlocked for purchase by completing “ The Five Teachings ” Myth quest. This is itself unlocked by completing the “ Takezo the Unrivalled ” Myth quest, but beating “The Five Teachings” will be no easy feat so early in the game.

Once you’ve beaten it, you can then purchase the Autumn Straw Hat from any Ainu Merchant. These nomadic folk can often be found wandering the open fields of Ezo, but if you want a guaranteed spot to find them, head north through to the Nayoro Wilds region, past the Great Lake. After a boat ride, you’ll arrive in Husko Kotan, with some Ainu Merchants in the southwestern side of town.

The Soaring Peak Straw Hat is a helmet that must first be unlocked for purchase by completing “ The Five Teachings ” Myth quest. This is itself unlocked by completing the “ Takezo the Unrivalled ” Myth quest, but beating “The Five Teachings” will be no easy feat so early in the game.

Once you’ve beaten it, you can then purchase the Soaring Peak Straw Hat from any Ainu Merchant. These nomadic folk can often be found wandering the open fields of Ezo, but if you want a guaranteed spot to find them, head north through to the Nayoro Wilds region, past the Great Lake. After a boat ride, you’ll arrive in Husko Kotan, with some Ainu Merchants in the southwestern side of town.

The Warrior’s Endurance Patch is a unique Helmet for not being a helmet OR a hat. It’s an eyepatch! It can be found in the Esan Inlet, which is a tiny strip of coast on the southeastern border of the Oshima Coast.

The Esan Inlet is just east of the Budding Grace Shrine, and south of Kasuga Village, an Occupied Location.

On the top of the cliff overlooking the inlet, you’ll want to look for a grapple trunk marked with red and white fabric that allows you to start your descent down. On the Map screen it’s just a touch north of the “N” in Esan.

When you get to the bottom, head northeast along the bottom of the cliff until you come across a raised section with two trees on top, surrounded by wooden ship wreckage at the bottom. Climb up it from the northeastern side to find a chest at the top: the eyepatch will be inside!

The Sumi-e Headbands are just like the normal Headbands, only these are only obtained by completing Sumi-e Paintings. Similar to the archer hats in the Outfit Hats section, these will have Atsu's artwork adorning them.

A tree stands unwavering in plum fields.

Location: Ishikari Plain - Rumoi River - Defiant Roots Sumi-e

The Headband of Fortitude is the reward for the Defiant Roots Sumi-e, which is located at the Rumoi River in the northern area of Ishikari Plain. The painting spot will be south of the “Rumoi River” label on the map screen, and west of the “Masked Man’s Quarry” Occupied Location.

In the field of purple flowers, you’ll want to look for the tall rock covered in yellow-flowered vines that quite literally sticks out in an area so barren of trees, overlooking the island in the river with a single tree on it. Sit here at the painting spot to get the Headband of Fortitude!

Location: Ishikari Plain - Otaru Beach - Crashing Waves Sumi-e

The Headband of Defiance can be acquired at the Crashing Waves Sumi-e, which is at Otaru Beach, the southwestern coast of Ishikari Plain. You’ll be looking for two tall rock formations on the shore, north of the Nishin Fishery and west of the Coastal Cave.

You’ll need to climb up to the top of the rock formation to do the painting. Head for the southern side of the smaller rock formation to find some handholds and a grapple trunk that pave the way to the top. There, run along the tightrope to the larger rock formation.

On the other side of the tightrope, use some more handholds to climb up to the top where the Sumi-e Painting spot will be!

Location: Teshio Ridge - Hakodake Mountains - Howling Pack Sumi-e Painting

The Headband of the Wild is the reward for completing the Howling Pack Sumi-e Painting. It can be found in the Hakodake Mountains, which is in the northern area of Teshio Ridge. Despite this, you'll actually find it at a cluster of intersections due west of the "Sentinel Forest" label on the map screen.

Here, close to a red torii gate leading up to the Enduring Hold Shrine, will be a small cliff with this Sumi-e's painting spot on top.

Colors change. Leaves fall. The cycle begins anew.

Location: Tokachi Range - Tomamu Marshlands - Season's Colors Sumi-e Painting

The Headband of the Seasons is the reward for completing the Season's Colors Sumi-e Painting in the Tomamu Marshlands, the southeastern region of Tokachi Range. It's located halfway between the "Tomamu" in the Tomamu Wastelands label on the map screen, and the border to the south where a Dueling Tree is.

Just north of the Dueling Tree will be the painting spot, facing south towards the Dueling Tree. As always, keep an eye out for the tall rock covered in yellow-flowered vines.

A mountain watches over. Nature flourishes.

Location: Yotei Grasslands - Serpent’s Pass - Mount Yotei Sumi-e

This headband can be found at the Mount Yotei Sumi-e Painting spot. This is located in Serpent’s Pass, which is the north-eastern area of the Yotei Grasslands.

Travel northwest along the Nupur River, but keep an eye out on your right for a pale torii gate among white flowers. Behind it is a path leading through a narrow pass.

Here, hug the rock wall on your left and follow it uphill.

At the top you’ll find the Sumi-e painting spot to the right of the tall rock with yellow-flowered vines.

Location: Nayoro Wilds - Cukpet Hills - Iwor Woods settlement - Drying Bark Sumi-e

The Headband of Tranquility is the reward for completing the Drying Bark Sumi-e, found in the northern half of the Nayoro Wilds. Specifically it’s in the “Iwor Woods” settlement in Cukpet Hills in the southwestern corner. This is NOT to be confused with the Iwor Woods area just north of it!

Head for this village by taking the winding path up from the river. When you arrive, look for the telltale rock with yellow-flowered vines on it to mark the painting spot: it’ll be next to the top of the waterfall.

Location: Yotei Grasslands - Shikotsu River - Plum Crane Sumi-e

This headband can be found at the Plum Crane Sumi-e spot in the Yotei Grasslands. Specifically it’s on Shikotsu River, to the west of Lake Shikotsu where Atsu’s House is.

Visible on the map will be a marshland area, and when you arrive it’ll be covered in purple flowers. There’s a rise in the middle with the Sumi-e rock with yellow-flowered vines. Head there to find the spot to paint.

This section houses all of the Hats and Helmets added for the Complete Edition's Echoes of Sekigahara and the Most Wanted Mode. Note that it also includes many Hats that DO NOT require the Complete Edition to access, as they were added in the 2.002 update available for everyone.

Prerequisite: Fully heal the Ashoro Foothills and restore Ashoro Springs

Location: Ashoro Foothills - Shari Fields - Ashoro Springs

This headband is in a rather hidden location, because it doesn't become available until you meet a set of rather specific requirements. In particular, you'll need to all but fully heal the Ashoro Foothills, as well as two quests that help restore the Ashoro Springs. The quests that do this are:

After doing all of these, return to Ashoro Springs and look for a woman in white near the middle of town who you can talk to. She'll be near a large rock between the main Inn building and the Communal Cookhouse.

When you talk to her, she'll mention a fox named Momo who used to visit the town, but appears to have been driven off by the Vipers.

Face the large red tree, then check the hot spring to the left of it to find Momo the fox: interact with it, and Atsu will feel inspired to paint the town in a Sumi-e Painting. Complete it, and you'll receive this headband!

It's never too late to change the path you walk on.

Prerequisite: Progress " The Gentle Giant " Tale quest

Location: Ashoro Foothills - Blooming Trails

This headband is also a somewhat hidden Sumi-e Painting. To get it, you'll need to progress " The Gentle Giant " Tale quest, which you can start by finding the camp atop the river cliff east-southeast of Ashoro Springs.

After doing this, you can find the Tale's second part at the lowest waterfall of the river directly west of Ashoro Springs. Here you can find a campsite to progress the quest: do so, and Atsu will paint a Sumi-e, unlocking this headband!

How to get: Buy the Champion of Democracy Dye for 10 Boss Tokens

This Helldivers II -referencing helm is unlocked in the Most Wanted mode. First, you'll need to defeat Lord Saito for the first time: after doing that, you can find the Champion of Democracy Dye available for 10 Boss Tokens: buy it to also unlock this helmet!

Issued to those serving the Western Army in the battle of Sekigahara.

How to get: Complete the " A Buried Promise " Revenge quest

The Western Army Hat is the hat for the Armor of the Western Army outfit. It's unlocked automatically by completing the " A Buried Promise " Revenge quest.

Owned by a gentle soul forced into a world of violence.

How to get: Complete " The Gentle Giant " Tale quest

Location: Ashoro Foothills - Akan Woodlands

Koroku's Hat is the reward for completing " The Gentle Giant " Tale quest, a quest we partially described above for the New Direction Headband. This hat is acquired by fully completing the Tale, which is done in the Akan Woodlands in the southern part of the Ashoro Foothills.

Location: Ashoro Foothills - Blooming Trails - Riverside Fox Den

The Forest's Bounty Hat is a helm located near the Riverside Fox Den, located in the Blooming Trails area on the western border of the Ashoro Foothills.

From the Riverside Fox Den, head directly southwest towards a gravel slope heading into a small valley. At the bottom, squeeze through the gap on your left: on the other side, look right to spot a chest. Open it to get this hat!

Location: Ashoro Foothills - Howling Waters - Colorful Dye Grounds

Cost: 12 Flowers at the Colorful Dye Merchant

Koromodako's Folly is a hat that is exclusively available at the Colorful Dye Merchant in the Ashoro Foothills.

You can find his Dye House in the Howling Waters area in the northern part of the region, just south of the "R" in the "Howling Waters" label on the map screen. It'll initially be occupied by Vipers, so you may have to clear them out first.

Once the area has been liberated, you can buy this from the Colorful Dye Merchant for 10 Flowers.

Pre-requisite: Complete the " A Mother's Love " Tale quest

Location: Ashoro Foothills - Moashoro River - Fortune's Asobiya

The Tracker's Straw Hat is the rare open-world Vanity Item that requires you to complete a different quest before it appears. You'll need to first complete the " A Mother's Love " Tale quest at Fortune's Asobiya, which Atsu scopes out with her spyglass when she first arrives in Ashoro Springs.

After completing this quest, head for the bottom of the cliff to find a woman who was thrown down there from the top. To the left of her is a chest: open it to get the hat!

The Sun Touched Straw Hat is a Complete Edition hat that's actually available to all players of Ghost of Yōtei: you can buy it for 10 Flowers at Taro the Scavenger. You can find his permanent spot at Dead Man’s Tree in Ohara Plains, on the western side of Tokachi Range.

Location: Ashoro Foothills - Howling Waters

The Judgement's Path Hat is a Vanity Item that can be found in the open world, specifically the Ashoro Foothills, meaning it's exclusive to the Echoes of Sekigahara DLC .

You can find it in the Howling Waters area at the northern end of the region. Here, check the north-eastern border (directly north of the "Waters" of the "Howling Waters label on the map screen) to find an overturned cart surrounded by some skeletons. This chest will be on the wheel of the cart.

Cost: 10 Flowers at the Colorful Dye Merchant

The Midnight Mukade Hat is one of the items available from the Colorful Dye Merchant in the Ashoro Foothills, making it exclusive to the Echoes of Sekigahara DLC .

Cost: 10 Ghost Flowers from the Mysterious Merchant

The Dawn Mukade Hat is one of the hats available from the Mysterious Merchant, Masujiro the Melodious, who is only accessible in New Game + . It will cost you 10 Ghost Flowers.

The Ocean's Storm Straw Hat is one of the hats available from the Mysterious Merchant, Masujiro the Melodious, who is only accessible in New Game + . It will cost you 10 Ghost Flowers.

The Trapper's Straw Hat is one of the hats available from the Mysterious Merchant, Masujiro the Melodious, who is only accessible in New Game + . It will cost you 10 Ghost Flowers.

Cost: 5 Flowers at the Colorful Dye Merchant

The Trodden Straw Hat is one of the items available from the Colorful Dye Merchant in the Ashoro Foothills, making it exclusive to the Echoes of Sekigahara DLC .

Once the area has been liberated, you can buy this from the Colorful Dye Merchant for 5 Flowers.

The Silent Straw Hat is one of the items available from the Colorful Dye Merchant in the Ashoro Foothills, making it exclusive to the Echoes of Sekigahara DLC .

Cost: 7 Flowers at the Colorful Dye Merchant

The Dark Gaze Hat is one of the items available from the Colorful Dye Merchant in the Ashoro Foothills, making it exclusive to the Echoes of Sekigahara DLC .

Once the area has been liberated, you can buy this from the Colorful Dye Merchant for 7 Flowers.

Viewed kindly by the gods. A touch of inspiration.

The Heavenly Thoughts Hat is one of the hats available from the Mysterious Merchant, Masujiro the Melodious, who is only accessible in New Game + . It will cost you 10 Ghost Flowers.

Location: Ashoro Foothills - Blooming Trails - Makami Bridge

The Floating Scale Hat can be found in the open wilds of the Ashoro Foothills, meaning it's exclusive to the Echoes of Sekigahara DLC .

To the east-southeast of Ashoro Springs is the Makami Bridge, which spans over a river chasm. Use the handholds to climb down from the bridge to the river, then check under the southern end of the bridge for a chest with this hat inside.

Location: Yōtei Grasslands - Yōtei River - White Dye House

Cost: 7 Flowers at the White Dye Merchant

The Kindness in Death Hat is a hat that can only be purchased from the White Dye Merchant. You can find her in the Yōtei River area in the northwestern part of the Yōtei Grasslands.

Look for it on the southern side of the river, close to the Yōtei River Bamboo Strike. You can find the White Dye Merchant standing outside the main building. Talk to her and buy the helmet!

How to get: Complete the " Lady Kitami " Bounty

This helmet is one of the rewards for completing the " Lady Kitami " Bounty, which is unlocked by clearing two Ashoro Foothills Bounties (assuming at least one of them isn't related to the " Ashoro Springs " Revenge quest). After completing the Bounty, you'll automatically get this helmet!

A sanctuary for those seeking to rest their wings.

How to get: Free and follow the Golden Bird in the Ashoro Foothills

The Nature's Promise Helmet is found via rather unique means. While roaming the Ashoro Foothills, you may encounter a small Viper camp boasting about capturing the Golden Bird that's been helping Atsu locate points of interest throughout her adventures.

Defeat the Vipers, free the bird, then follow it to a tall dead tree with a package hanging from a rope. Cut the rope with one of your bows, then collect it to get this Helmet!

Taken from Snake Contender Bunzaemon, betrayed by his own men, left alive to pay for the slaughter he caused.

Location: Ashoro Foothills - Blooming Trails - Nishimura Slaughterhouse

How to get: Complete the " Bunzaemon the Butcher " Bounty

The Butcher's Helmet is one of the rewards for completing the " Bunzaemon the Butcher " Bounty. This can be done by liberating the Nishimura Slaughterhouse on the western border of the map, directly north of the "Trails" in the "Blooming Trails" label on the map screen.

You'll get this helmet automatically for liberating the Nishimura Slaughterhouse by defeating Bunzaemon the Butcher and his men.

A helmet left behind from a land across the sea.

Prerequisite: Complete the " Another Man's Treasure " Revenge quest

The Foreign Helmet is a unique helmet from Portugal, which only appears after you've completed the " Another Man's Treasure " Revenge quest.

After you've done so, you'll unlock " A Past and Present Battle ". Head to its starting point in the Howling Waters area at the northeastern border of the map. Here, check to the right of the entry point to find a chest next to an abandoned cart: open it for the helmet!

If this chest isn't present, it's probably because you travelled here on foot. To fix this, fast travel to refresh the game world, spawning the chest.

Taken from Snake Contender Umakichi who claimed the strength of a bear but died like a pig.

Location: Ashoro Foothills - Moashoro River - Umakichi's Grasp

How to get: Complete the " Umakichi the Bear Slayer " Bounty

This helmet is a reward for completing the " Umakichi the Bear Slayer " Bounty. This can be done by clearing out Umakichi's Grasp, a hunting ground at the northeastern end of Moashoro River on the northeastern border of the Ashoro Foothills.

You'll get the helmet automatically after clearing out the area and defeating Umakichi and his men.

Taken from Nobushige the Unbreakable. Heavy is the burden of war torn memories.

Location: Ashoro Foothills - Toshibetsu Falls

How to get: Complete the " Nobushige the Unbreakable " Bounty

This helmet is a reward for completing the " Nobushige the Unbreakable " Bounty. This is a multi-part Bounty that takes you all across the Ashoro Foothills, ending in a final duel at Toshibetsu Falls.

Read the page linked below to learn where to find Nobushige and how to defeat him.

How to get: Upgrade The Wolf's Chosen Armor to Level II.

The Mourning Helmet can be obtained by collecting The Wolf's Chosen Armor . This is obtained in the identically-named "The Wolf's Chosen" Myth quest, which you get mandatorily when Atsu scouts the Ashoro Foothills with her spyglass when first arriving.

Once you've done that, head for Ginju the Armorer to upgrade the armor to Level II. Ginji can be found at every Inn, or summoned directly to a fresh campsite via the Wolf Pack menu.

How to get: Upgrade the Wolf's Chosen Armor to Level IV.

The Howling Helmet can be obtained by collecting The Wolf's Chosen Armor, then upgrading it to Level IV at Ginji the Armorer. Ginji can be found at every Inn, or summoned directly to a fresh campsite via the Wolf Pack menu.

The Blind Judgement Hat is one of the items available from the Colorful Dye Merchant in the Ashoro Foothills, making it exclusive to the Echoes of Sekigahara DLC .

Cost: 5 Flowers at the Crimson Dye Merchant

The Bleeding Judgement Hat can be found at the Crimson Dye Merchant in Ishikari Plain. To find her, head for the Crimson Dye Beach on Stone Jaw Coast, located north-northwest of Ishikari Castle.

Here you’ll find the Crimson Dye Merchant’s workplace, but she’s currently out on her boat. To summon her, locate the campfire and light a fire there to draw her to shore.

The Eyes of Fire Hat is one of the items available from the Colorful Dye Merchant in the Ashoro Foothills, making it exclusive to the Echoes of Sekigahara DLC .

How to get: Complete " The Nature of War " Revenge quest, then collect from any Onryō Gift Altar.

The Stag's Grace Hat is obtained by completing " The Nature of War " Revenge quest, then collecting it from any Onryō Gift Altar.

The Elegant Fortitude Hat is one of the items available from the Colorful Dye Merchant in the Ashoro Foothills, making it exclusive to the Echoes of Sekigahara DLC .

Cost: 7 Flowers at the Crimson Dye Merchant

The Crescent Blood can be found at the Crimson Dye Merchant in Ishikari Plain. To find her, head for the Crimson Dye Beach on Stone Jaw Coast, located north-northwest of Ishikari Castle.

Cost: 7 Flowers at the Blue Dye Merchant

The Crescent Mist Helmet is a Vanity Item you can get at the Blue Dye Merchant, located in Oshima Coast.

You can find her Dye House on Otsuki River upstream from the Oiso Fishing Village, where you can buy this for 7 Flowers.

A glimpse of treasure. A sunrise of gold.

The Gilded Crescent Hat is one of the items available from the Colorful Dye Merchant in the Ashoro Foothills, making it exclusive to the Echoes of Sekigahara DLC .

The Crescent Death Helmet is a hat that can only be purchased from the White Dye Merchant. You can find her in the Yōtei River area in the northwestern part of the Yōtei Grasslands.

Cost: 7 Flowers at the Black Dye Merchant

The Broken Beauty Helmet is available from the Black Dye Merchant in Teshio Ridge.

You can find her home, the Black Dye House, near the western end of the Teshio River, just a bit west of the Frozen Moment Sumi-E Painting spot. However at first her wares are suspiciously limited. You'll need to first complete " The Way of the Shamisen ", after which you'll be able to browse her full stock.

Prerequisite: Complete the " Bunzaemon the Butcher " Bounty quest

The Jade Skin Helmet is one of the items available from the Colorful Dye Merchant in the Ashoro Foothills, making it exclusive to the Echoes of Sekigahara DLC . However, it doesn't appear in his stock until you first complete the "Bunzaemon the Butcher" Bounty quest at the Nishimura Slaughterhouse.

You can find the Colorful Dye House in the Howling Waters area in the northern part of the region, just south of the "R" in the "Howling Waters" label on the map screen. It'll initially be occupied by Vipers, so you may have to clear them out first.

Once the area has been liberated, you can buy this from the Colorful Dye Merchant for 12 Flowers.

The Akan's Embrace Helmet is one of the items available from the Colorful Dye Merchant in the Ashoro Foothills, making it exclusive to the Echoes of Sekigahara DLC .

The Quiet Perspective Hat is one of the items available from the Colorful Dye Merchant in the Ashoro Foothills, making it exclusive to the Echoes of Sekigahara DLC .

Location: Ashoro Foothills - Shrouded Claw

The Empty Promises Hat is a Vanity Item that can be found in the open wilds of the Ashoro Foothills. It is located in the Shrouded Claw area on the southeastern border of the region. Head for the southeastern end of the river that cuts through that area.

Here you'll come across a waterfall: check the base of the left-hand cliff to find a chest with this hat inside. There may also be a small camp here with a Bounty Poster for Munetaka the Horse Thief.

The Sun Touched Straw Hat is a Complete Edition hat that's actually available to all players of Ghost of Yōtei: you can buy it for 10 Flowers at Taro the Scavenger.

You can find his permanent spot at Dead Man’s Tree in Ohara Plains, on the western side of Tokachi Range.

To those who create, to those who play, the sun rises on the stories lived.

Prerequisite: Complete the " Umakichi the Bear Slayer " Bounty

The final hat in the game can be found at Umakichi's Grasp, however you won't be able to access it until you complete the " Umakichi the Bear Slayer " Bounty.

After doing so, look for a bear cub in the middle lake area and follow it to a spot where you can yank down some rocks. Climb all the way to the river at the top.

Here, you'll find four totems representing some of Sucker Punch's past works. Bow to each one by swiping down on the touchpad, and you'll get this Headband!
